title: Deployment
viz_content: SELECT replace_all(deployment_id, char(39), '') AS deployment FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_time > now() - 30d AND deployment_id != '' GROUP BY deployment_id ORDER BY max(event_time) DESC LIMIT 50

title: Active sessions
description: Sessions with at least one event in the selected window.
viz_content: SELECT uniq(session_id) AS sessions FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND ('{{filter_agent}}' = 'all' OR agent_type = '{{filter_agent}}') AND ('{{filter_deployment}}' = 'all' OR deployment_id = '{{filter_deployment}}')

title: Tool calls
description: Finished tool calls in the selected window.
viz_content: SELECT count() AS tool_calls FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND ('{{filter_agent}}' = 'all' OR agent_type = '{{filter_agent}}') AND ('{{filter_deployment}}' = 'all' OR deployment_id = '{{filter_deployment}}') AND event_type = 'tool_complete'

title: Tokens (input + output)
description: Input and output tokens of all model requests in the selected window.
viz_content: SELECT to_int64(sum(metric_value)) AS tokens FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_metrics) WHERE event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND ('{{filter_agent}}' = 'all' OR agent_type = '{{filter_agent}}') AND ('{{filter_deployment}}' = 'all' OR deployment_id = '{{filter_deployment}}') AND metric_name IN ('llm.input_tokens', 'llm.output_tokens')

title: Open threats
description: Threats not yet acknowledged or cleared, whatever their age.
viz_content: SELECT count() AS threats FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_threats) WHERE (status = '' OR status = 'open') AND ('{{filter_deployment}}' = 'all' OR deployment_id = '{{filter_deployment}}')

title: Events over time by agent type
description: Normalized CIM events (prompts, model requests, tool calls). The bar width follows the time range.
viz_content: SELECT *, concat(to_string(time), ' ', to_string(agent_type)) AS k FROM (SELECT format_datetime(to_datetime(int_div(to_unix_timestamp(event_time), greatest(60, int_div(date_diff('second', now() - {{filter_time_range}}, now()), 60))) * greatest(60, int_div(date_diff('second', now() - {{filter_time_range}}, now()), 60))), '%m-%d %H:%M') AS time, agent_type, count() AS events FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND ('{{filter_agent}}' = 'all' OR agent_type = '{{filter_agent}}') AND ('{{filter_deployment}}' = 'all' OR deployment_id = '{{filter_deployment}}') GROUP BY time, agent_type ORDER BY time) ORDER BY time

title: Most active sessions
description: The eight sessions with the most events. Copy a session id into the Session Trace dashboard to see its steps.
viz_content: SELECT e.session_id AS session_id, e.agent AS agent, e.project AS project, e.events AS events, e.tool_calls AS tool_calls, to_int64(m.tokens) AS tokens, d.detections AS detections, e.last_event AS last_event FROM (SELECT session_id, any(agent_type) AS agent, array_element(split_by_char('/', any_if(json_value(raw_event_data, '$.cwd'), json_value(raw_event_data, '$.cwd') != '')), -1) AS project, count() AS events, count_if(event_type = 'tool_complete') AS tool_calls, max(event_time) AS last_event FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND ('{{filter_agent}}' = 'all' OR agent_type = '{{filter_agent}}') AND ('{{filter_deployment}}' = 'all' OR deployment_id = '{{filter_deployment}}') GROUP BY session_id) AS e LEFT JOIN (SELECT session_id, sum(metric_value) AS tokens FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_metrics) WHERE metric_name IN ('llm.input_tokens', 'llm.output_tokens') GROUP BY session_id) AS m ON m.session_id = e.session_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT session_id, count() AS detections FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_security_events) GROUP BY session_id) AS d ON d.session_id = e.session_id ORDER BY events DESC LIMIT 8
